2609.05324.title: RoboSPA: Can VLA Models Go Beyond Simple Scenes and Short-Horizon Tasks?
2609.05324.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, existing datasets and benchmarks mainly evaluate task completion under predefined settings, offering limited insight into model reasoning under increasing spatial and procedural complexity. We introduce \textbf{RoboSPA} (\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment), a large-scale robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark for diagnosing embodied reasoning in VLA models. \texttt{RoboSPA} focuses on two core dimensions, Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning and Long-Horizon Procedural Planning, covering 10 task categories and 56 base tasks. Each task is instantiated across five difficulty levels, yielding 280 variants with increasing spatial ambiguity and procedural complexity. We collect 527K trajectories across multiple embodiments and diverse scenes. Beyond binary success rate, \texttt{RoboSPA} introduces diagnostic metrics for more detailed evaluation. Experiments on representative VLA models show that current systems still struggle with complex spatial relations, precise low-level execution, and memory-intensive planning. These results establish \texttt{RoboSPA} as a challenging diagnostic benchmark for developing more capable, reliable, and generalizable embodied agents. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA.
2609.05324.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型在語言條件下的機器人操作方面顯示出有希望的進展。<lb/>然而，現有的數據集和基準主要評估在預定義設置下的任務完成情況，對於模型在日益增長的空間和程序複雜性下的推理提供的見解有限。<lb/>我們介紹了\textbf{RoboSPA}（\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment），這是一個大規模的機器人操作數據集和基準，用於診斷VLA模型中的具身推理。<lb/>\texttt{RoboSPA}專注於兩個核心維度，細粒度空間推理和長期程序規劃，涵蓋10個任務類別和56個基本任務。<lb/>每個任務在五個難度級別中實現，產生280個變體，具有日益增長的空間模糊性和程序複雜性。<lb/>我們收集了527K的軌跡，涵蓋多個具身體和多樣的場景。<lb/>除了二元成功率外，\texttt{RoboSPA}還引入了診斷指標以進行更詳細的評估。<lb/>在具有代表性的VLA模型上的實驗顯示，目前的系統在複雜的空間關係、精確的低級執行和內存密集型規劃方面仍然面臨挑戰。<lb/>這些結果確立了\texttt{RoboSPA}作為一個具有挑戰性的診斷基準，以開發更具能力、可靠性和可泛化性的具身代理。<lb/>我們的數據和代碼可在https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA獲得。
